mapper.insert: INSERT INTO odin_formation_run_pages ( run_guid, formation_guid, page_no, page_status, frame_start, frame_end, total_count, completed_count ) VALUES ( #{page.runGuid}, #{page.formationGuid}, #{page.pageNo}, #{page.pageStatus}, #{page.frameStart}, #{page.frameEnd}, #{page.totalCount}, #{page.completedCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_guid, formation_guid, page_no, page_status, frame_start, frame_end, total_count, completed_count FROM odin_formation_run_pages WHERE run_guid = #{runGuid} AND page_status = 'Pending' ORDER BY page_no ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, run_guid, formation_guid, page_no, page_status, frame_start, frame_end, total_count, completed_count FROM odin_formation_run_pages WHERE run_guid = #{runGuid} ORDER BY page_no ASC

SELECT id, run_guid, formation_guid, page_no, page_status, frame_start, frame_end, total_count, completed_count FROM odin_formation_run_pages
ORDER BY page_no ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE odin_formation_run_pages SET page_status = 'Claimed', claim_owner = #{claimOwner}, claim_token = #{claimToken}, lease_expire_time = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND) WHERE id = #{id} AND page_status = 'Pending'
UPDATE odin_formation_run_pages SET page_status = 'Running' WHERE id = #{id} AND page_status = 'Claimed'
UPDATE odin_formation_run_pages SET page_status = 'Completed', completed_count = total_count WHERE id = #{id}
